cases.title: Account security renders for Super Admin: 2FA Off, "Set up two-factor", workspace policy card (switch disabled until own 2FA on)
Enable flow: QR + secret shown; Cancel returns; wrong code shows error; correct TOTP shows 10 recovery codes
Recovery codes: Download produces a file, Copy gives feedback, "I've saved them" hides them and shows the 2FA On state with remaining count
Policy switch now enabled; turning it on requires 2FA for everyone (DB tenants.require_mfa=1); admin is forced to the security screen
Turning the policy off releases admins again (require_mfa=0)
New recovery codes: needs a valid current code; success replaces all codes (old code no longer works)
Disable: requires password + code; wrong password -> error; correct -> 2FA Off in DB, secret and codes wiped
Disable with a recovery code instead of an authenticator code works
Security screen API failure shows an error note; Agent can open own security page
